question: Name the popular dance of North-West India in which dancers balance multiple pots or pitchers on their head while standing on top of glass bottles or on the rim of a brass plate.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhavai**

 
 
• Bhavai is a folk dance form from **Rajasthan**, India.
 
• It is performed by women who balance multiple pots on their heads while dancing.
 
• The pots can be made of clay or metal, and can be decorated with colorful designs.
 
• The dancers also perform other feats, such as dancing on broken glass or the edge of a sword.
 
• Bhavai is a physically demanding dance form that requires a great deal of skill and practice.
 
• It is a popular tourist attraction in Rajasthan, and is often performed at festivals and other cultural events.
 
• The dance is accompanied by traditional Rajasthani music.
 
• The dancers wear colorful costumes and jewelry.
 
• Bhavai is a unique and mesmerizing dance form that showcases the rich culture of Rajasthan.
 
• It is believed that this dance form evolved from the exceptional balancing skills of women from certain communities in Rajasthan, who would carry multiple pots of water on their heads
